I can't take it anymore...|Fyson|BotW}} |game= BotW, TotK |other= |era= [[Era of the Wilds]] |family= {{List| * [[Guy]] {{Small|(husband)}}{{Cite|My wife runs a general store in Rito Village. I'm not one to brag, but she's the most beautiful lady you ever will see. Our son runs a store of his own in some town or other, but I'm not entirely sure of all the details. The town itself was apparently established fairly recently in northeast Hyrule.|Guy|TotK}} * [[Fyson]] {{Small|(son)}} }} |voiceactor= |theme= |counter= }} {{Term/Store|Misa||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|Misa|Game Screen|BotW}}{{Cite|Misa|Game Screen|TotK}} ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Misa is a [[Rito]] woman who owns [[The Slippery Falcon]] in [[Rito Village]]. She is assisted by her son [[Fyson]] before he leaves for [[Tarrey Town]], and she wants him to take over the [[General Store]] one day.{{Cite|My mom said she wants me to take over the family store someday...
Can you believe that?!|Fyson|BotW}} Misa can always be found at the back of The Slippery Falcon, and she welcomes [[Link]] when he walks inside.{{Cite|Welcome!|Misa|BotW}} When spoken to, she will repeat her greetings to Link.{{Cite|Welcome to the {{Color BotW|Blue|Slippery Falcon}}, the legendary Rito general store! You look beat! Working hard, eh?|Misa|BotW}}{{Cite|Hello...and welcome to the Rito general store, the {{Color BotW|Blue|Slippery Falcon}}.|Misa|BotW}}{{Cite|Hey! Welcome to the {{Color BotW|Blue|Slippery Falcon}}!|Misa|BotW}} She then asks what he needs from her.{{Cite|Was there something you needed?|Misa|BotW}} If Link asks about The Slippery Falcon's stock, Misa explains that they provide everything from self-defense [[Item]]s to [[Cooking]] ingredients.{{Cite|[What do you sell?] We carry just about everything—from items for self-defense to everyday groceries.|Misa|BotW}} She encourages Link to buy her ingredients, and she allows him to read her ''[[Misa's Recipe Book|Recipe Book]]'' to learn how to use them.{{Cite|By all means, please peruse the {{Color BotW|Blue|book of recipes}} there, and buy some of our fine ingredients!|Misa|BotW}}{{Cite|You can find recipes that use our featured ingredients in the {{Color BotW|Blue|book of recipes}} over there.|Misa|BotW}} When Link makes a purchase at The Slippery Falcon, Misa will thank him.{{Cite|Yes, sir. Thank you!|Misa|BotW}} If he buys the entire stock of one product, Misa promises to replace it soon.{{Cite|Thank you! We'll make sure to stock up on that.|Misa|BotW}} Like other vendors, Link can also sell his own [[Item]]s to Misa.{{Cite|[Here to sell.] Sure thing. Show me what you're selling.|Misa|BotW}}{{Cite|Anything else you want to sell?|Misa|BotW}}{{Cite|Any other items you'd like me to take off your hands?|Misa|BotW}}{{Cite|Choose the items you want to sell!|Misa|BotW}} When she buys one of Link's Items, she gladly gives him his [[Rupee]]s and thanks him.{{Cite|OK, here you go!|Misa|BotW}}{{Cite|OK!|Misa|BotW}}{{Cite|Thank you very much!|Misa|BotW}}{{Cite|Thanks so much!|Misa|BotW}} At the end of their conversation, Misa encourages Link to return.{{Cite|Come back soon!|Misa|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Fyson * Guy * Misa's Recipe Book * Rito * Rito Village * The Slippery Falcon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Hyruleans, Rito, Rito Villagers |characters= BotW, TotK }}
